svg.text: Figure 1: Two-Stage Decoupled Framework for Generative Recommendation & Pre-Exposure Compliance Auditing

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: Qhf7/Rec-Agent · Strict Information Isolation Between Reason Generation (Rec-Agent v2) and Probabilistic Gatekeeping (Jev-1.14.0 SystemOne)
Strict JSON Output Contract (1–3 Cards / User)
• exposure_reason (≤24 CJK chars): Scene Hook + Fact + Benefit
• Constraints: No prices/discounts, no internal paths or Jev fields
• Auditability: tool_trace (separates unqueried vs. ignored facts)
• Coverage Gate: {category, functions, scenes, price} completeness
• Provenance: row-level pointer to canonical CSV/JSON
• Lexicon Matching: lexicon_hits against 72 compliance terms
• Baseline B1: Pure rule baseline evaluated on identical split
1. Parallel Typed Decision Protocol (No Free-Form Text)
• Confidence check: c_min = min(c_Q1, c_Q2, c_Q3)
Extracts exact paths (item.functions, lexicon) + schema check
Only Approved Clicks Return to MCP
Soft ranking prior for Rec-Agent (Never Jev)
Closed-Loop Feedback: Approved Clicks → MCP History (Isolated from Jev)
Anti-Leakage Firewall (No Lexicon/Labels to Agent; No Exposure Logs to Jev)
